Ilse's correction is there, posted the same morning (Oct 14, ts …125). She said she'd read the wrong line. Dana is a member of #north-random, so that message was already visible to them.
- **Stale reply:** my Oct 14 reply in #north-team still says 261 and calls it the current number. In Dana's answer I said that reply is out of date, so the thread doesn't mislead anyone.
- **No document:** there's nothing under `accounts/quarrendon` in the shared files, so I couldn't check the figure against renewal paperwork. I suggested Dana ask Ilse if they want it confirmed from the paperwork.
- **GBrain:** looking up the account now returns only the 100-seat note, not the 261 one I saved on the 14th. The brain is already up to date.
